liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Space** (2 reviews, 2 other sources): The space section includes repeated teases of Wang Dang Doodle, which the band had first played on Aug 26, 1983 in Portland; Reviewer finds the space raw and tribal, with Kesey on thunder machine [3][6][14][22]
- **Althea** (1 review): This Althea has a slower grind to it [23]
- During the second-encore Satisfaction, the crowd jumped around and sang at the top of their lungs [19]
- The double encore ends with the crowd in full singalong, and Bobby cannot find a place to fit in [25]

## Setlist highlights

- **Thanks You's & Credits**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]

## The recordings

- **gd1983-08-31.148767.fob.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 159 min [1]
- **gd1983-08-31.142927.beyerm201.holbrook.flac2448**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 150 min [3]
- **gd1983-08-31.aud.unknown.34928.flac16**: audience recording; 24 songs; 148 min; rated 3/5 by 3 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer rates this the best of three audience tapes posted, especially strong in the low end; Reviewer says levels on this audience source run too high; a Tetzeli 421 source sounds better; Master levels run somewhat hot; right channel dropped out for the first 1:43 of Me & My Uncle and was patched from left [5][15][16]
- **gd1983-08-31.111598.Sennheiser.daweez.d5scott.flac16**: source not stated; 23 songs; 147 min; rated 4.2/5 by 5 [6]. Said about its sound: Reviewer hears Jerry as strong in the first set and somewhat less so in the second; Reviewer finds the sound good and especially enjoys the jams and tribal groove [21][23]
- **gd1983-08-31.senn421.dodd-repitched.84934.flac16**: audience recording; 22 songs; 139 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [9]. Said about its sound: The re-pitched Sennheiser 421 transfer fixes the original's slightly chipmunk-like pitch [17]

## Around the show

- Audience was very into it; ushers sent dancers back to their rows until the second encore [19]
- The theater was brand new; the top balcony sounded acoustic, like an opera house; taper recorded all three nights [20]
- Wang Dang Doodle had first been played at the Portland show on Aug 26, 1983, days before this one [14]
- Reviewer prefers the rest of the tour to these three Eugene shows and rates this four stars, sound okay [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1983-08-31.148767.fob.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: source: Mark Severson's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics (mounted in a hat)(row U, seat 104) > Jamie Pouris' custom preamp/NX40 dbx encoder > Sony… [1]. Also: Master is a FOB cassette from Mark Severson, transferred by Charlie Miller, with pitch correction help from Joe B. Jones; A Sennheiser 421 FOB source from Otto Rice supplies a nine-second patch in Drums [1]
- **gd1983-08-31.142927.beyerm201.holbrook.flac2448**: taped by Executive Crew, Kyle Holbrook, Chris Kidwell, Tom Pinney; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: flac24/48 Master: AUD MC Beyer M201's X-Y 5.5'up > Sony TCD5M no dolby Nakamichi ZX-C90 x 2 Location: 100 feet from stage, DFC (2 rows behind SBD) [3]. Also: Taper stopped the tape deliberately after Good Lovin', so the encore is not on this recording [3]
- **gd1983-08-31.aud.unknown.34928.flac16**: source: AUD > unknown mics > Sony TC-D5 > Cassette [5]. Also: Copied in 1983 from a local Oregon taper; mics are unknown but likely Sennheisers, with D5 and noise reduction off noted; Second-set tape flip is patched from the LAMA source, making the set seamless [5]
- **gd1983-08-31.111598.Sennheiser.daweez.d5scott.flac16**: taped by Da Weez; transferred by D5scott; source: Source: 2 Sennheiser 421 microphones > Sony TC-D5M - analog master cassettes; [6]. Also: Taper used a portable Aiwa stereo recorder with an Aiwa stereo mic on his hat, from the rear top balcony [20]
- **gd1983-08-31.senn421.dodd-repitched.84934.flac16**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: AUD (Senn. 421�s)>MC>DAT>CDREac >cool edit > shntool > cdwav >shnv3 [9]
